body:
1. **Rain and snow on the precipitation shaft by default** (behavioral):
     `sgs_precip_incloud_fraction` 0 → 1 and `sgs_precip_fraction_floor` 0.5 → 0.1.
     Spread uniformly over the cell, rain evaporates 2.5–4.5× the rate of 3.75 km
     MPAS truth within ne30 cells; on the shaft, ~0.9–1.4×.
  2. **Opt-in updraft rule for the variance fidelity α**
     (`sgs_variance_fidelity_model: updraft`, PrognosticEDMFX + non-equilibrium
     microphysics; default `equilibrium` unchanged). Where updrafts are cloudy, α is
     blended toward `α σ_S = c_u q_c,up` (in-cloud updraft condensate), bounded to
     `[α_min, 1/(1 − w_eq)]` and weighted by the updraft cloud cover and EDMF
     lower area-limiter factor.
title: 1M: place rain/snow on the precipitation shaft by default; opt-in updraft rule for α

body:
This PR moves AtmosphericProfilesLibrary into ClimaAtmos as a submodule and drops the external dependency. The port is a formatting-only copy of upstream 0.1.10, verified by a normalized diff of all 15 profile files. Main was pinned to 0.1.8. It adds the existing APL docs page in the References section. Copilot's auto-review found a pre-existing GATE III tendency conversion bug and a Float32 promotion in the Bomex cooling rate, this will be fixed in a followup PR #4958 

To verify that the code matches APL 0.1.10, run the following from the Atmos repo root:
```julia

using Pkg; Pkg.activate(temp = true)
Pkg.add(name = "AtmosphericProfilesLibrary", version = "0.1.10")
import AtmosphericProfilesLibrary as APL0

clean(x) = x
clean(s::AbstractString) = join(strip.(split(strip(s), '\n')), '\n')
clean(e::Expr) = Expr(e.head, (clean(a) for a in e.args if !(a isa LineNumberNode))...)
ast(f) = clean(Meta.parseall(read(f, String)))

upstream = joinpath(pkgdir(APL0), "src", "profiles")
for f in readdir(upstream)
    same = ast(joinpath(upstream, f)) == ast(joinpath("src", "atmospheric_profiles_library", f))
    println(rpad(f, 24), same ? "same" : "DIFFERS")
end
```
Output, TRMM differs because I added a LinearAlgebra import:
```
ARM_SGP.jl              same
Bomex.jl                same
DryBubble.jl            same
Dycoms_RF01.jl          same
Dycoms_RF02.jl          same
GABLS.jl                same
GATE_III.jl             same
ISDAC.jl                same
Larcform1.jl            same
LifeCycleTan2018.jl     same
Nieuwstadt.jl           same
Rico.jl                 same
SP.jl                   same
Soares.jl               same
TRMM_LBA.jl             DIFFERS
```
title: Port AtmosphericProfilesLibrary into Atmos
